# Generated by tools/build_energy_crisis.py. Parent ideas retain their real modifiers.
# Back out the former custom dynamic contribution once, preserving reforms.
TFR_EST_migrate_energy_crisis_ledger = {
    if = {
        limit = { tag = EST has_country_flag = TFR_EST_initialized }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = TFR_EST_economy_industrial_capacity_factory_var }
                    NOT = { has_variable = TFR_EST_economy_consumer_goods_factor_var }
                }
            }
            TFR_EST_initialize_country_modifiers = yes
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = TFR_EST_energy_factory_applied } } set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_factory_applied = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = TFR_EST_energy_goods_applied } } set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_goods_applied = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    check_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_factory_applied value = 0 compare = not_equals }
                    check_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_goods_applied value = 0 compare = not_equals }
                }
            }
            subtract_from_variable = { var = TFR_EST_economy_industrial_capacity_factory_var value = TFR_EST_energy_factory_applied }
            subtract_from_variable = { var = TFR_EST_economy_consumer_goods_factor_var value = TFR_EST_energy_goods_applied }
            set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_factory_applied = 0 }
            set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_goods_applied = 0 }
            TFR_EST_refresh_country_modifiers = yes
        }
    }
}

TFR_EST_reconcile_energy_crisis = {
    if = {
        limit = { tag = EST has_country_flag = TFR_EST_initialized }
        TFR_EST_migrate_energy_crisis_ledger = yes
        set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_response_steps = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ratas_lng_connection has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_kallas_lng_connection has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_reform_2023_grid_connection has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ekre_2023_narva_blocks has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_centre_2023_power_reserves has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_isamaa_2023_dispatchable_reserve has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_sde_2023_renewable_contracts has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_e200_2023_renewable_permits has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_pp_2023_renewable_permits } }
            add_to_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_response_steps = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ratas_grid_synchronisation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_kallas_gas_reserve has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_reform_2023_grid_connection has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ekre_2023_narva_blocks has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_centre_2023_power_reserves has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_isamaa_2023_dispatchable_reserve has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_sde_2023_renewable_contracts has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_e200_2023_renewable_permits has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_pp_2023_renewable_permits } }
            add_to_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_response_steps = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ratas_renewable_chp has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_kallas_energy_networks has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_reform_2023_wind_permits has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ekre_2023_kiisa_reserve has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_centre_2023_local_chp has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_isamaa_2023_grid_connection has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_sde_2023_grid_connection has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_e200_2023_grid_connection has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_pp_2023_grid_connection } }
            add_to_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_response_steps = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ratas_building_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_kallas_energy_households has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_reform_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ekre_2023_regulated_power has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_centre_2023_apartment_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_isamaa_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_sde_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_e200_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_pp_2023_continuity_capacity } }
            add_to_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_response_steps = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ratas_network_charge_relief has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_kallas_energy_networks has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_reform_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_ekre_2023_regulated_power has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_centre_2023_apartment_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_isamaa_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_sde_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_e200_2023_renovation has_country_flag = TFR_EST_done_pp_2023_continuity_capacity } }
            add_to_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_response_steps = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { TFR_EST_energy_crisis_active = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_energy_crisis_seen } }
                set_country_flag = TFR_EST_energy_crisis_seen
                country_event = { id = tfr_estonia_ratas.1 }
            }
            # Adopt an already present weaker parent tier, never worsen or stack it.
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_energy_idea_managed } }
                set_country_flag = TFR_EST_energy_idea_managed
                set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_external_recovery = 0 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash5 } set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_external_recovery = 4 } }
                else_if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash4 } set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_external_recovery = 3 } }
                else_if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash3 } set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_external_recovery = 2 } }
                else_if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash2 } set_variable = { TFR_EST_energy_external_recovery = 1 } }
            }
            set_temp_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery value = TFR_EST_energy_response_steps }
            add_to_temp_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery value = TFR_EST_energy_external_recovery }
            clamp_temp_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery min = 0 max = 5 }
            if = {
                limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery value = 5 compare = equals } }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash1 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash1 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash2 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash2 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash3 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash3 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash4 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash4 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash5 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery value = 4 compare = equals } }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash1 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash1 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash2 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash2 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash3 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash3 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash4 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash4 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash5 } } add_ideas = GER_oil_crash5 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery value = 3 compare = equals } }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash1 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash1 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash2 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash2 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash3 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash3 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash5 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash5 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash4 } } add_ideas = GER_oil_crash4 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery value = 2 compare = equals } }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash1 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash1 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash2 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash2 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash4 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash4 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash5 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash5 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash3 } } add_ideas = GER_oil_crash3 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { check_variable = { var = TFR_EST_energy_effective_recovery value = 1 compare = equals } }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash1 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash1 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash3 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash3 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash4 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash4 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash5 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash5 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash2 } } add_ideas = GER_oil_crash2 }
            }
            else_if = {

                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash3 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash3 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash4 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash4 }
                if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash5 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash5 }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash1 } } add_ideas = GER_oil_crash1 }

        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_country_flag = TFR_EST_energy_idea_managed }
            if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash1 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash1 }
            if = { limit = { has_idea = GER_oil_crash2 } remove_ideas = GER_oil_crash2 }
